name: White Quilted Motorcycle Jacket
copy:
BALENCIAGA
White Quilted Motorcycle Jacket
Fall/Winter 2004

Nicolas Ghesquière drew on a book about New York's early-1980s graffiti artists for Balenciaga's Fall/Winter 2004 collection. Its motocross references appeared in this padded-shoulder motorcycle jacket, shown as Look 17.

Leather motorcycle jacket with a herringbone lining.

· Stand collar with snap closure
· Zip closure
· Diagonal zips at waist
· Quilted shoulder panels
· Zipped cuffs

Made in France.

CHRISTIAN DIOR
White Gothic Logo Tank Top

John Galliano designed the Gothic logo tank for Dior’s Spring/Summer 2002 ‘Street Chic’ collection, which drew on hip-hop sportswear. A version in sheer mesh carried ‘1947’ on the back, the year Christian Dior presented his first collection.

Jersey tank top.

· Bound scoop neck and armscyes
· ‘Christian Dior’ print at front
· Chest 15.7 x length 19.3 x shoulders 10.6 in

Made in Italy.

name: Beige Crystal Fishnet Tank Top Set
copy:
DOLCE & GABBANA
Beige Crystal Fishnet Tank Top Set
Early 2000s

Domenico Dolce and Stefano Gabbana paired mesh and crystals on bras they showed as tops for Spring/Summer 2000, a combination they returned to on the fishnet tank. Jennifer Lopez wore a version in her 2002 video for ‘Jenny from the Block’, styled by Andrea Lieberman.

Fishnet and rib-knit cotton tank top set.

· Crystal trim at scoop neck and armscyes of outer tank
· Fishnet extends below inner hem
· Chest 14.2 x length 22.4-25.6 in

Made in Italy.

name: White ‘Holy’ Tank Top
measurements: Chest 16.9 x length 26.8 x shoulders 12.8 in
copy:
ANN DEMEULEMEESTER
White ‘Holy’ Tank Top
Spring/Summer 1998

Ann Demeulemeester made the ‘Holy’ tank for Spring/Summer 1998 after hearing Patti Smith’s ‘Spell’, a recording of Allen Ginsberg’s ‘Footnote to Howl’. She chose the shape after seeing her son in a man’s tank top and gave one to each guest at her ‘Corps Humain’ show to pass on the poem’s idea that everyone was holy.

Rib-knit tank top.

· Bound scoop neck and armscyes
· Script print at chest
· Logo printed at upper back
· Chest 16.9 x length 26.8 x shoulders 12.8 in

COMME DES GARÇONS
Black Feathered Mesh Top

Rei Kawakubo reworked Victorian and Edwardian tailoring for ‘Dark Romance, Witch’, her Fall/Winter 2004 collection for Comme des Garçons. The top she showed at the Lido in Paris pairs a sheer bodice with one tailored sleeve and a feathered shoulder.

Sheer mesh top.

· Bound neckline and right armscye
· Vertical bands at front and back
· Iridescent feathers and netting at left shoulder above a single long sleeve
· Chest 15.7 x length 18.5 x shoulders 12.2 x sleeve 25.2 in

measurements: Chest 14.2 x length 29.5 x shoulders 15.4 x sleeve 30.3 in

JEAN PAUL GAULTIER
Black Tie-Front Medallion Cardigan
Fall/Winter 2007

Jean Paul Gaultier reproduced Pierre-Auguste Cot’s 1880 painting ‘The Storm’ in the medallion on the back of this Maille Femme cardigan. He showed the same image facing forward on an openwork knit in his Fall/Winter 2007 collection, which drew on dress from the Scottish Highlands.

Openwork wool-blend cardigan.

· Rib-knit stand collar
· Four knit ties across open front
· Curved hem
· Flared cuffs
· Chest 14.2 x length 29.5 x shoulders 15.4 x sleeve 30.3 in

Made in Italy.

name: Navy Hooded Cardigan
measurements: Chest 23.6 x length 30.9 x raglan sleeve 33.7 in
copy:
MAISON MARTIN MARGIELA
Navy Hooded Cardigan
Fall/Winter 2005

Maison Martin Margiela designed the cardigan for Fall/Winter 2005, inspired by the way people pull a coat collar over their heads to shelter from the rain. The extended collar drapes across the shoulders and becomes a hood when pulled up.

Wool-and-silk knit cardigan.

· Button closure
· Rib-knit hem that rises at centre back
· Rib-knit cuffs
· Four exposed label stitches at upper back
· Chest 23.6 x length 30.9 x raglan sleeve 33.7 in

Made in Italy.

RAF SIMONS
Black ‘Penelope Jaws’ Hoodie

Raf Simons drew on Ashley Bickerton’s collages of brand logos for ‘Consumed’, his Spring/Summer 2003 collection. Working with Peter De Potter, he paired a photograph of Penelope Tree at Truman Capote’s 1966 Black and White Ball with the shark from Steven Spielberg’s ‘Jaws’.

Loopback cotton jersey hoodie.

· Graphic above and below kangaroo pocket
· Fading throughout
· Chest 19.7 x length 29.1 x shoulders 18.9 x sleeve 27.6 in

name: Black Reconstructed Trousers
copy:
MAISON MARTIN MARGIELA
Black Reconstructed Trousers
Fall/Winter 2002

Martin Margiela began Artisanal in 1989 with a vest assembled from found porcelain shards. For Fall/Winter 2002, the house used reconstruction in its tailoring, joining matte upper panels to lustrous fabric below the thighs on these wide-leg trousers.

Reconstructed wide-leg trousers.

· Belt loops at waistband
· Matte upper panels
· Lustrous lower panels
· Wide legs

name: Pale Leather Lace-Through Boots
copy:
DIRK BIKKEMBERGS
Pale Leather Lace-Through Boots
1990s

Dirk Bikkembergs drew on military, mountaineering and work boots for his footwear in the 1980s. The laces on this 1990s pair pass through an opening in the heel and wrap around the upper, an early signature recalling climbing footwear.

Leather lace-up boots.

· Round toes
· Laces wrap around the shafts
· Folded leather at ankles
· Stitched sole edges
· Creasing at ankles

· Silver-tone hardware
